description: Who is waiting on whom. `waitingOnThem`: threads whose LAST message is yours (SENT) and has had no answer for at least nudgeAfterDays — candidates for a nudge; a note to yourself (every To and Cc address is the account's own primary address, in any spelling Gmail delivers to it: +tags, dots, googlemail.com) is left out; one other recipient keeps it. `waitingOnMe`: threads still in the inbox whose last message came from someone else — a person, not a newsletter or an automated notice by its own headers — oldest first. Decided on each thread's last message and its LIVE labels: the search index only proposes candidates (`in:sent` / `in:inbox` within the last `days`), so a thread the index still files under the inbox after it was archived is dropped, as in search. Drafts, trash and spam messages do not count as a thread's last word. Scans at most `max` threads per side; `hasMore` says when more candidates existed. A thread with no recorded date is left out rather than given an invented age. USE WHEN: 'what am I waiting on?', 'who have I not answered?', 'what should I follow up on?' DO NOT USE: as an inbox overview (use triage_digest) or to read a thread (use get_thread). SIDE EFFECTS: none.
name: follow_ups
